title: DocMind AI
impact: Enabled fast, context-grounded document Q&A with controlled response modes for accuracy and flexibility
description: An AI-powered document intelligence platform that allows users to upload PDFs, index their content using vector embeddings, and perform high-speed, context-aware question answering using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
challenge: Reviewing large PDF documents is time-consuming, and traditional LLM systems often produce ungrounded or overly generic responses without strict adherence to source content.
approach: Designed a RAG pipeline with structured document ingestion, semantic chunking, and configurable response modes to balance strict grounding with flexible expert-level insights.
solution: Built a full-stack Next.js application integrating MongoDB vector search and Groq-powered inference to deliver real-time, document-aware responses with selectable behavior modes.
features: PDF upload and automated text extraction pipeline
Semantic chunking and embedding generation for retrieval
MongoDB vector search for high-speed similarity matching
Multi-mode response system (strict, expert, summary)
Strict mode for fully grounded, source-only answers
Expert mode for document-based insights with extended reasoning
Summary mode for concise, high-level outputs
Persistent document catalog for ongoing query access

title: AI Business Analyst
impact: Enabled evidence-backed business insights with traceable reasoning across large document sets
description: AI Business Analyst is a document-grounded business intelligence assistant built on an Agentic RAG workflow. It ingests business documents, chunks and stores them in MongoDB, retrieves relevant evidence using vector search with fallback ranking, and returns structured answers with confidence and evidence traces.
challenge: Business teams struggle to extract actionable insights from large document collections, while traditional RAG systems lack reasoning transparency, confidence validation, and adaptive query planning.
approach: Designed an agentic planner-executor loop that dynamically retrieves, evaluates, and refines responses using semantic search, confidence scoring, and iterative re-planning.
solution: Built a full-stack system using Next.js and MongoDB that combines vector search with an agent-based reasoning pipeline, enabling multi-step analysis, evidence tracing, and structured output generation.
features: Multi-document upload and persistent document management
Semantic chunking and embedding generation for retrieval
Document-scoped and cross-document query modes
Agentic planner-executor loop with dynamic re-planning
Multi-step reasoning: retrieval, analysis, recommendations, synthesis
Evidence-backed responses with confidence scoring
Traceable outputs linking insights to source documents
Document lifecycle management (list, delete, update)
